related_questions.question: How serious is fibrosis of the lungs?
related_questions.snippet: Long-standing pulmonary fibrosis increases your risk of developing lung cancer. Other lung problems. As pulmonary fibrosis gets worse over time, it may lead to serious problems such as blood clots in the lungs, a collapsed lung or lung infections.
